name: paseo-tidetable
description: TideTable sidebar and workspace panel for Paseo, driven by `tidetable sidebar --json`, from a local todo file or a TideTable hub.

paseo.description: Read-only TideTable sidebar: current, concurrent, upcoming, phase tree, overall tree.

todo.description: Path to the TideTable todo file, or the project slug when a server is set (falls back to TIDETABLE_TODO env).

server.description: Base URL of a `tidetable serve` hub, e.g. https://tidetable.example.com. Empty = read the local todo file (falls back to TIDETABLE_SERVER env).

token.description: Bearer token for the hub (falls back to TIDETABLE_TOKEN env). Prefer the env var on shared machines.
